headline: Pakistan army chief Asim Munir to visit Tehran on Tuesday (Reuters)
dek: Pakistan's army chief Asim Munir will visit Tehran on Tuesday — days after Pakistan's DG ISPR pledged 'absolute' support for Saudi Arabia ('whatever support is needed').
fault_line: Pakistan hedging — or playing Riyadh and Tehran off each other?

sections.what_happened: Pakistan's army chief Asim Munir will visit Tehran on Tuesday — days after Pakistan's DG ISPR pledged 'absolute' support for Saudi Arabia ('whatever support is needed').

totw_analysis: Our read: 'The split, not the bloc': same week Pakistan pledges absolute support to Saudi Arabia, its army chief heads to Tehran — the Gulf hedging story in one frame. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Pakistan hedging — or playing Riyadh and Tehran off each other?
